scope: One narrow synthetic Chromium print-controls check using production frontend assets and an existing calendar fixture. window.print is stubbed; calendar output is Chromium-generated PDF. Original-PDF print link is checked by identity and options only. No physical printer, hospital workstation, Windows native preview, backend PDF integrity or real report processing is tested.

checks.name: Print calendar invokes the current selected month and scanner in scoped print mode
Calendar printing restores the application title and screen mode
Print stylesheet excludes sidebar, app header and calendar controls
Printed calendar retains scanner heading and wraps day text without cell clipping
Selected monthly receipt calendar fits one landscape PDF page
Generated PDF includes selected month, scanner, receipt totals, final days and clinical distinction
Generated PDF excludes application controls and navigation
Print PDF links to the complete selected original in a protected new tab with100% and its toolbar enabled
Print PDF label and tooltip explain the native browser print controls
Print UI sends no processing mutations and introduces no browser errors or external requests
